question: In what enduring manner must the disciple bear the liṅga upon the three limbs?
premises: Bearing the liṅga applies to three limbs.
The state must be maintained always.
inference: The disciple must always be one who bears the liṅga on the three limbs.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the three limbs is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Always be one who bears the liṅga on the three limbs.
